actor: Extreme-quantization research lead at a funded open-weight model lab or big-tech research group
job: Running quantization-aware training and distillation to push a 20B-plus open-weight model below 2 effective bits per weight while holding 90% benchmark retention.
outcome: A published sub-2-bit checkpoint of a 20B-plus model under 5 GB on disk, with a multi-benchmark evaluation reporting 90%-plus retention against its full-precision baseline.
motivation: A shipped 1.125-bit build holding 90% retention proved the encoding reproducible; clearing the memory wall first defines the portable tier.

task.what: run quantization-aware training and distillation below 2 bits per weight
task.where: the lab's training cluster and quantization evaluation harness
task.why: post-training quantization collapses below 3 bits, so training-time methods are required
task.how: quantization-aware training, distillation, and the Apache-2.0 reference encoding on Hugging Face

actor: Open-weight foundation-model family release owner deciding which family member claims the portable tier
job: Funding the training-time compute for a sub-2-bit build of the family's 20B-plus model and clearing its open-weight release under a permissive license.
outcome: Open weights published for the family's 20B-plus model at 2 or fewer effective bits per weight and no more than 5 GB on disk.
motivation: Every open-weight family faces the same handset memory wall; whoever clears it first sets which of their models counts as portable.

task.who: model release, licensing, and research-leadership sub-teams
task.what: approve compute budget and publish a sub-2-bit open-weight build
task.where: the family's release pipeline and its Hugging Face model repository
task.why: the first family to clear the memory wall defines portable
task.how: permissive open-weight licensing plus a published multi-benchmark retention evaluation

actor: Open-weight release engineer at the lab that first shipped a sub-2-bit 20B-class model
job: Maintaining the Apache-2.0 weights, kernels, and encoding recipe in public so outside groups can inspect and reproduce the sub-2-bit method.
outcome: An inspectable, permissively licensed reference encoding that a second group can reproduce on a different open-weight family.
motivation: Open publication makes the result travel rather than stay a one-off, and establishes the lab's encoding as the method others build on.

task.who: the lab's open-source release and inference-kernel sub-teams
task.what: publish and maintain weights, kernels, and the quantization recipe
task.where: public Hugging Face and GitHub repositories
task.why: an inspectable artifact is what lets outside groups reproduce the encoding
task.how: Apache-2.0 licensing on Hugging Face and GitHub
